name: Copper Ridge / Chilliwack River Loop
notes: NPS loop recommendation combining the Hannegan Pass approach, three Copper Ridge camps (Silesia, Egg Lake, Copper Lake), and the Chilliwack River camps. A route with the same trailhead on both ends still requires checking road access and river crossings.

name: Devil's Dome Loop
notes: The iconic 40–41 mile loop uses the East Bank Ross Lake Trail and Devil's Ridge/Jackita Ridge; much of the high ridge is outside the park in Pasayten Wilderness. Boat-camp entries are included only where the walking corridor reaches the Ross Lake shore; verify whether a particular permit allows that camp type.

name: Rainbow–McAlester Loop
notes: Popular Stehekin-area loop over McAlester Pass. Dan's Camp, Rainbow Meadows, Rainbow Lake and McAlester Lake are the individual-camp options; mileage varies with the chosen Rainbow Loop access.

name: Big Beaver / Little Beaver Traverse
notes: Remote north-unit one-way route linking Big Beaver, Beaver Pass and Little Beaver. The NPS lists Big/Little Beaver as a dedicated corridor; lake-shore boat camps are not interchangeable with hiker camps, so the route should be confirmed with a ranger before booking.

name: Thunder Creek / Park Creek / Cascade Pass Traverse
notes: NPS long-distance sampler corridor from the east side through Thunder Creek, Park Creek Pass and Cascade Pass. Bridge Creek and group/stock variants are colocated; this list keeps the regular individual camps where the source data provides them.
